title: Transcription Post-Recording Pipeline
requirements: Add DiaryStore.setTranscript(for id: UUID, source: TranscriptSource, text: String) async throws that writes the transcript text into the entry's .md via temp-write + osrename (same atomic pattern as append), then updates entry.source and entry.updatedAt in manifest.json in place

In RecordingViewModel.stop(), after recorder.stop() returns a non-empty URL, call the injected service.transcribe(at:) and iterate the AsyncStream<TranscriptUpdate>; set isFinalizing = true while streaming and false on terminal update
On .final(Transcript): call store.setTranscript, set completedEntry, invoke onCompleted
On .failed: set a typed error state on RecordingViewModel and persist the entry with source .none and empty transcript — never build a DiaryEntry from an empty URL
Route EntryDetailViewModel's blur-save (saveIfChanged) through store.setTranscript instead of store.update so inline transcript edits persist to .md, closing the gap left by ISSUE-015
acceptance_criteria: Stopping a 5-second recording yields a non-empty transcript within 10 seconds (faster on-device if Speech succeeds; longer for Whisper fallback)
After transcription, manifest.json shows the updated source and updatedAt, and the .md contains the transcript text
stop() without start() produces no completedEntry (guaranteed by recorder-stop-error-handling)
Transcript writes are atomic (temp + rename); a crash mid-write leaves a consistent prior state
notes: Implementation deviates from the literal 'stop() calls store.setTranscript' wording in requirement 3 for a hard lifecycle reason: setTranscript requires the manifest row to already exist, but that row is only created downstream in ContentView.finishRecording via store.append. stop() therefore runs the transcription pipeline and exposes the final Transcript via the new completedTranscript field + the widened onCompleted(entry, transcript) callback; finishRecording appends then calls setTranscript. This preserves the PRD's intent (transcript persists to .md and updates manifest source/updatedAt atomically) at the correct point in the lifecycle.
stop() exposes completedTranscript: Transcript? (and transcriptionError: String for the .failed path) as out-parameters rather than calling store.setTranscript itself.
